en: The Guide:
Chapter 1. On Compendium.
Homage to that Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Perfectly Self-Awakened One.
That which the world worships,
and which the world-protectors always revere—
this is his excellent teaching.
The wise should know the object of knowledge for the Best of Men.
This discourse consists of twelve sections;
all of it, both in its phrasing and its meaning, [should be understood].
Both of these are to be understood:
what is the meaning and what is the phrasing?
The Guide has sixteen modes of conveying the teaching.
The investigation of the Teaching has five methods;
it was set forth by Mahākaccāna with eighteen root-terms.
The necklace, the investigation of the phrasing,
the three methods of the discourse, and the meaning of the discourse—
both of these are fully grasped.
It is called a "sutta" according to the sutta itself.
Both the teaching and that which was taught— both of these should be understood.
In this regard, the sequence is as follows:
"The ninefold search for the discourses.
This is the section on grouping.
